book.name: 2 TIMOTEUS
book.title: 2 TIMOTEUS Timoteus tuku waŋe Paulusŋge arnu kuyarna

content: Ne pasa te katese mayewa. Ait kugawam patukuwa le piti ait prowamŋgat.

Taŋgo pino naŋgine ŋgarosu ndo idusniŋmba minamŋgaig. Nane ndametiŋ kilam piririmba naŋgine nyu ndo payamkamŋgaig. Nane afu tumail panniŋmba ina mam tuku miŋge pitaikamŋgaig. Afuŋge nane turkuwaig ta nane gare pasa niŋge ndaka nane Kuate mata ŋgumnewamŋgaig.
Nane afu ŋgamuŋgal niŋge nda. Nane gubra maŋau kusre ndamba naŋgine nzali ŋaigonu fare fare dubikamŋgaig. Nane ŋerŋerka maŋau magenu ŋakmba pitaikamŋgaig.

Nane gulab kame kilmba ŋgueu mbal niŋgamŋgaig. Nane wamdus kugatok fare fare maŋau ke lika naŋgine ŋgarosu ndo payamkamŋgaig. Nane naŋgine gare tam tuku wamdus suŋgo tumba Kuate fudiŋmba ndo idusamŋgaig.
Nane ŋgarosu ndo Kuate dubimba nu tuku saŋgri idus ndamba ŋgumnewamŋgaig. Taŋgo kame taŋaŋ ne nane ŋgumneniŋga.
Mbal ta nane gulab taŋaŋ afu tugum kumba yabriniŋgig le pino kame afu wamdus saŋgri kugatok ta nane pasa ta ismba son ŋgade. Pino kame ta naŋgine mbar kame tuku piti kusrekam tuku wamdus kine inummba
mara mara taŋgo kise kise tuku pasa isig ta nane pasa tugusek kila palmbim kumuŋ kuga.
O bukok taŋgo Yanes le Yambres Moses te-ibeŋam bafunaik taŋamba ndo kile mbal taŋge pasa tugusek te-ibeŋam bafude. Nane tuku wamdus ŋayonu. Nane yabri wam ta tuku ndo son ŋgade.
Nane tuku wam saŋgrinu ait kuen mine nda. Yanes le Yambres nale tuku maŋau tugusek kuga ta kilimok mayok kina taŋamba wam ndui ta ndo nane mbolŋge kilimok mayok kaŋgat.

O Timoteus, ye tuku mine maŋau tugunu ket ta ne kila. Ye pasa kuklimba tumniŋget ta ne mata kila. Ye Kuate tuku son ŋga piti sinamŋge ŋgamuŋgal wamdus bulok ŋak saŋgri tiŋget. Ye tira kame tuku kume purmba piti sinamŋge bike ndaket. Wam ta ŋakmba ne kila.
Tumbraŋ Antiok Ikonium Listra nane piti seryinaig le rar sugo kugraken ta ne kila. Piti ŋakmba ta sinamŋge Suŋgo nu ye turyina.
Ima nu Kristus Yesus ndoŋ ulendika Kuate dubiwam iduste ta siŋka nane nu piti tambimŋgaig.
Yabri mbal wam ŋaigonu kade mbal ŋakmba nane tuku maŋau lato lato suŋgo ŋayowamŋgat. Nane mbal afu yabriniŋguwaig le Satan nu mbilka nane yabriniŋgamŋgat.
O Timoteus, ne sine tuku wam tugusek ta ne kila. Ne sine tuku pasa ismba kila pilmba son ŋgina ta biye demba mina.

Ne kiŋo fudiŋndo minna sulumba Kuate tuku kuyar pasa kila pilna. Kuyar pasa ta ne muskil te-tiwam tuku ndin tumnate. Ande nu Kristus Yesus tuku kume tuku saŋgri tomba tiŋgate ta Kuate nu muskil te-tiwe tuwit.

Kuate tuku kuyar pasa ŋakmba nuŋe miroŋ saniŋgina le kuyarke likinaig. Sine Kuate tuku mbal kumumbi mayok ka piro magenu ŋakmba ke likam tuku saŋgri ŋak minbe ŋga nu pasa ta siŋgina. Pasa taŋge sine kumumbi wam paguka mbar maŋau kile-mayokka kile-tidiŋgate sulumba maŋau tiŋreknu ndo tumsiŋgit le kila pileg.
